brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset: Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, PNG, landscape approximately 16:9.
Create a new thumbnail using the attached approved image ONLY as the ink/brush style and black-lime color reference. Do not reuse the reference player, name, score, or date. This article is a collective pre-game selection, with no single player as protagonist.
Subject: one vividly hand-inked orange basketball and a few abstract court lines on the right. No people, no faces, no hands, no uniforms, no logos, no sponsor text, no scoreboards or scenes claiming a real play.
Design: background #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, off-white bold Japanese typography, hand-made brush streaks, restrained ink texture, spacious editorial composition. Text at left and center, ball at right. Keep 6% safe margins. No text clipping.
Render ONLY these exact strings, with the main headline largest:
"バスケまとめ"
"2026.10.26"
"B.PREMIER"
"登録選手"
"ベスト5"
"本日の対戦クラブから"
"今季平均EFFで独自選出"
"出場確定ではありません"
"記事掲載情報：10/26 02:23時点"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Hierarchy: 登録選手 / ベスト5 is the main two-line headline. The two lines 本日の対戦クラブから / 今季平均EFFで独自選出 must be clearly legible together underneath, defining the selection scope. 出場確定ではありません must be clearly legible in its own band. The article timestamp and two AI disclosure lines go along the bottom in smaller but clear text. Do not add any other numbers, player names, claims, actual results or rankings.

qa_notes.text_and_numbers: 出力画像で全11文字列を目視照合。日付10/26、記事時点02:23、ベスト5一致。得点・勝敗・順位の追加なし。
